module rates.cache.scenarios
use rates.cache

scenario "an entry is served until its ttl passes" {
  given clock = FakeClock.new()
  given _ = Rates.set("EUR", 11000, Some(5m))
  given _ = clock.advance(4m)
  when  before = Rates.get("EUR")
  then  before == Ok(Some(11000))
}

scenario "an entry expires under the fake clock" {
  given clock = FakeClock.new()
  given _ = Rates.set("EUR", 11000, Some(5m))
  given _ = clock.advance(6m)
  when  after = Rates.get("EUR")
  then  after == Ok(None)
}

scenario "rate refills an expired entry from the quote" {
  given clock = FakeClock.new()
  given _ = Rates.set("GBP", 1, None)
  given _ = clock.advance(10m)
  when  r = rate("GBP")
  then  r == Ok(12700)
  then  Rates.get("GBP") == Ok(Some(12700))
}

rates.cache: breaking

    + pub fn rate(code: Str) -> Result<Int, RateError> with {mut, nondet}
      (changed signature, breaking)
  Added:
